settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Second Battle of El Alamein 1942, British Eighth Army infantry POV, moonlit desert, minefield lanes, dust, artillery flashes, tank silhouettes in distance, authentic desert uniforms, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD. Prioritize desert scale, heat, dust, thirst, fatigue, careful movement and quiet pauses between major battlefield sounds.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite British Eighth Army infantry soldier POV during the Second Battle of El Alamein. One primary action and one camera movement per scene. No spoken dialogue, no narration and no intelligible human speech. Do not make every scene active combat. Use the desert itself as part of the experience: wind, sand, distant engines, boots, breathing, thirst, heat shimmer, moonlight and long periods of waiting. Several scenes should be quiet or nearly quiet so later artillery and movement feel heavier and more realistic.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic first-person desert warfare reenactment, cold moonlight transitioning to harsh daylight, textured sand, dust on fabric and weapon metal, restrained cinematic camera. Camera movement should feel tired, cautious and physically weighted. Preserve dust buildup, sweat, dryness and gear continuity.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP03 — El Alamein: Through the Devil's Gardens
movie.storySummary: A fictional British Eighth Army infantry soldier advances through the minefields and artillery-lit desert during the Second Battle of El Alamein, ending as the Axis defensive line breaks and the Allied advance continues west.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of a fictional composite British Eighth Army infantry soldier at El Alamein, 23 October–4 November 1942. Make the viewer feel dry wind, sand inside boots, dusty sleeves, the weight of water and ammunition, night cold, daytime heat, distant engines and the psychological strain of walking through marked minefield lanes. Do not use gunfire or explosions in every scene. Let silence, thirst, waiting and the huge empty desert carry several scenes. Tell everything visually. No spoken dialogue and no narrator. Human sound is limited to breathing and nonverbal exertion.

scenes.title: Before the Guns
scenes.description: A deliberately quiet night scene before the offensive begins.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rests both hands on the rifle at the trench edge and waits, feeling cool night wind move dust across the sandbags.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person British infantry POV in a shallow desert trench at night, dusty khaki sleeves, Lee-Enfield resting across hands, moonlit sand, coarse sandbag texture, dark artillery silhouettes far behind, condensation absent in dry air.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still POV with slight breathing sway. No firing, no explosion and no music. Audio foreground: controlled breathing, webbing creak, tiny grains of sand moving against cloth. Mid-ground: soft desert wind. Background: faint engine idle far away. Let silence dominate. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Barrage
scenes.description: The opening artillery bombardment erupts across the horizon after the quiet wait.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV flinches as distant batteries ignite the horizon and sand vibrates from sustained firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over desert as British artillery flashes stretch across horizon, dust lifting from trench edges, khaki sleeve and rifle visible in foreground, no close explosions on people.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static POV with one slow tilt across artillery flashes. Audio: massed artillery rolling from behind and across distance, sand vibration, loose metal rattle, startled breathing. The contrast with the previous quiet scene should be dramatic. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Forward
scenes.description: The infantry climbs out and begins the night advance.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV climbs from the trench and follows dispersed silhouettes into the dark desert, boots sinking slightly into loose sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person British soldier stepping into moonlit desert behind infantry silhouettes, dust around boots, artillery flashes behind, rifle held low and web gear shifting.
scenes.videoPrompt: One continuous forward climb and walk. Audio foreground: boots in sand, webbing, breathing. Background: barrage becomes slightly more distant as movement begins. Soldiers use only hand signals. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Minefield Markers
scenes.description: Engineers mark a safe lane through the defensive minefields.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier enters a narrow taped lane, eyes tracking each marker and disturbed patch of sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of pale tape markers forming a lane across dark desert minefield, engineer crouched beside route, boot prints and disturbed sand clearly visible, squad moving single file.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move between tape markers. Audio: tape flutter, measured boots, sand crunch, breathing and distant barrage. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: One Step at a Time
scenes.description: The squad advances carefully through the lane with almost all attention on footing.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV places each boot inside the marked path, pauses once to regain balance, then continues.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person downward view of dusty boots following taped minefield lane, small stones and boot prints in sand, squadmate feet ahead, dim moonlight and long shadows.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low walking POV focused on careful footsteps. Audio: individual sand crunches, fabric, breathing, tape flutter. Distant guns are faint and irregular. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Dust and Fire
scenes.description: A distant shell burst throws a rolling wall of dust across the route ahead.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV drops low as dust moves across the lane and keeps hands inside the marked route.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crouched in desert minefield lane, dust cloud crossing ahead, tape markers partly obscured, silhouettes low to ground, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops once to low cover. Audio: one distant shell burst, rushing dust, equipment clatter, sharp breathing; do not add continuous nearby firing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: First Light
scenes.description: A quiet dawn observation scene revealing the huge battlefield after the night advance.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier rises behind a low ridge and remains still while pale light spreads across smoke columns and distant tank silhouettes.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dawn view over El Alamein battlefield, granular sand ridge in foreground, pale blue-gold sky, smoke columns thinning, tiny infantry positions and tank silhouettes far away, dusty rifle edge visible.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow upward tilt over ridge to wide battlefield, then hold. No nearby firing and no music. Audio: desert wind, subtle fabric flutter, a distant engine, slow breathing; artillery only as a faint far rumble. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Tank Column
scenes.description: Allied tanks move through a cleared corridor behind the infantry.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a tank column passing through dust and shields the eyes briefly from blowing sand.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of historically plausible Allied tanks moving through cleared desert lane, track dust rolling low, infantry crouched nearby, dusty glove raised near face.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow pan toward passing tanks. Audio: tank engines, track clatter, wind carrying grit, breathing and fabric. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Hold the Ridge
scenes.description: The unit holds a low ridge under intermittent distant fire.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV settles behind a shallow scrape with rifle ready but waits rather than firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rifle over low desert scrape, dust and smoke beyond, squadmates spaced along ridge, dry cracked earth and spent dust on sleeves.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static low POV with one rifle settle action. POV does not fire. Audio: wind, sand movement, breathing, occasional far burst only. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Water
scenes.description: A deliberate recovery scene centered on thirst and exhaustion.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier slowly opens a metal canteen, takes one measured drink, then lowers it without rushing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty hands holding a scratched metal canteen in harsh desert light, sweat-darkened sleeve cuff, dry sand grains on knuckles, rifle resting nearby and background softly out of focus.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static close POV. No firing, no explosion, no music. Audio foreground: canteen cap turning, small water movement, swallowing, dry breathing. Mid-ground: light wind over sand. Background battlefield sound almost absent. Leave silence after the swallow. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Supercharge
scenes.description: Time shifts to the renewed push of Operation Supercharge.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV stands with stiff legs and joins infantry moving forward again through churned dusty ground.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person daylight desert advance with infantry line and tank silhouettes moving through churned ground, boots coated in pale dust, early November 1942.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single forward walking movement with advancing line. Audio: engines, boots, equipment and breathing, with artillery farther away rather than constant. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Past the Defenses
scenes.description: The soldier moves through abandoned defensive positions.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV steps slowly past empty sandbag positions, torn canvas and damaged equipment, looking before each step.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view moving through abandoned Axis trench line, weathered sandbags, loose canvas, disabled equipment and boot marks, no bodies shown, harsh sun and dust.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move through one abandoned position. Audio: wind, loose canvas flapping, distant engines, footsteps in sand, breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: The Road West
scenes.description: Retreating traffic is visible far beyond the broken line.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV raises binoculars toward distant vehicles moving west and holds them steady against wind.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person binocular view of distant desert road with vehicle columns withdrawing through heat haze and dust, no close combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: One binocular raise and hold. Audio: wind across microphone perspective, binocular handling, distant engines and tired breathing. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: Breakthrough
scenes.description: The unit advances beyond the former defensive belt.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad across open desert beyond the defensive line at a steady, fatigued pace.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person infantry movement across open desert with cleared minefield markers far behind, vehicles advancing nearby, dust-coated boots and sleeves.
scenes.videoPrompt: Steady forward movement west. Audio: boots, engines, wind, equipment movement and breathing; minimal battle noise. No speech, no narration.

scenes.title: End of the Beginning
scenes.description: The episode ends with the column advancing into the vast desert after the breakthrough.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV walks beside the moving column under a huge late-afternoon sky, occasionally looking down at tired steps.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view beside Allied column moving west across Egyptian desert, long shadows, dust hanging in warm low sunlight, boot prints behind, no triumphal staging.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward tracking beside column. Audio: engines, wind, boots and tired breathing. No gunfire nearby, no victory music, no speech, no narration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite British Eighth Army infantry soldier
characters.description: Anonymous first-person soldier with historically plausible 1942 British desert uniform and rifle; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: khaki desert uniform, web equipment, steel helmet, boots, Lee-Enfield rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Keep khaki sleeves, rifle, web gear and dust level consistent. Dust, sweat, dryness and fatigue accumulate naturally and must not reset between scenes; face not shown.

atmosphereAssets.title: Eighth Army Start Line
atmosphereAssets.description: Night desert trenches, cool dry air, coarse sandbags, distant engines and artillery positions; quiet anticipation before the barrage.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: cold moonlight and later artillery flashes

atmosphereAssets.title: Minefield and Forward Positions
atmosphereAssets.description: Marked tape lanes, disturbed sand, boot prints, low ridges, smoke, tank corridors, heat and dust; sound alternates between sparse wind and distant battlefield pressure.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: moonlight transitioning to pale dawn and harsh daylight

atmosphereAssets.title: Western Desert Beyond the Line
atmosphereAssets.description: Open desert, advancing columns, long horizons, heat haze, dust trails and increasing distance from the heaviest fighting.
atmosphereAssets.lighting: bright to warm late-day desert light
